# Inputs: events_list, allowed_countries, sheet_link, competitor_events
events_list        = input['events_list']
allowed_countries  = input['allowed_countries']
sheet_link         = input['sheet_link']
competitor_events  = input['competitor_events'] || []

# Country/City to flag mapping (used by your existing regional section)
flags = {
  "United States"  => "🇺🇸",
  "San Francisco"  => "🌉",
  "United Kingdom" => "🇬🇧",
  "France"         => "🇫🇷",
  "Germany"        => "🇩🇪",
  "India"          => "🇮🇳",
  "Japan"          => "🇯🇵",
  "Brazil"         => "🇧🇷",
  "Singapore"      => "🇸🇬",
  "South Korea"    => "🇰🇷",
  "Israel"         => "🇮🇱",
  "Spain"          => "🇪🇸",
  "Poland"         => "🇵🇱",
  "China"          => "🇨🇳"
}

# 2-letter country code -> flag (used by Competitor Events section)
flags_by_code = {
  "US" => "🇺🇸", "GB" => "🇬🇧", "FR" => "🇫🇷", "DE" => "🇩🇪",
  "IN" => "🇮🇳", "JP" => "🇯🇵", "BR" => "🇧🇷", "SG" => "🇸🇬",
  "KR" => "🇰🇷", "IL" => "🇮🇱", "ES" => "🇪🇸", "PL" => "🇵🇱",
  "CN" => "🇨🇳", "NL" => "🇳🇱", "CZ" => "🇨🇿", "HU" => "🇭🇺",
  "VN" => "🇻🇳", "TR" => "🇹🇷", "CA" => "🇨🇦", "UY" => "🇺🇾"
}

# Region headers (display order + emoji)
region_order = ["EMEA", "APAC", "AMER"]
region_headers = {
  "EMEA" => "🌍 *EMEA*",
  "APAC" => "🌏 *APAC*",
  "AMER" => "🌎 *AMER*"
}

# Fallback: infer group from country if missing in input
country_to_group = {
  "United Kingdom" => "EMEA", "France" => "EMEA", "Germany" => "EMEA",
  "Israel" => "EMEA", "Spain" => "EMEA", "Poland" => "EMEA",
  "India" => "APAC", "Japan" => "APAC", "South Korea" => "APAC",
  "Singapore" => "APAC", "China" => "APAC",
  "United States" => "AMER", "Brazil" => "AMER"
}

# Filter: allowed countries, exclude SF from main, events_count > 0
filtered = events_list.select do |item|
  allowed_countries.include?(item['country']) &&
    !item['country'].to_s.include?("San Francisco") &&
    item['events_count'].present? &&
    item['events_count'].to_i > 0
end

# Group by region (use group field if present, fallback to mapping)
grouped = filtered.group_by do |item|
  item['group'].presence || country_to_group[item['country']] || "OTHER"
end

# Helper: build per-sheet link with gid
def build_sheet_link(sheet_link, gid)
  if sheet_link.match?(/gid=\d+/)
    sheet_link.gsub(/gid=\d+/, "gid=#{gid}")
  elsif sheet_link.include?('#')
    sheet_link.gsub(/#.*/, "#gid=#{gid}")
  elsif sheet_link.include?('?')
    "#{sheet_link}&gid=#{gid}"
  else
    "#{sheet_link}#gid=#{gid}"
  end
end

# Build message
if filtered.any?
  message = "📊 *Events Update - #{Time.now.strftime('%b %d, %Y')}*\n\n"

  region_order.each do |region|
    items = grouped[region]
    next if items.nil? || items.empty?

    region_total = items.sum { |i| i['events_count'].to_i }
    message += "#{region_headers[region]} _(#{region_total} events)_\n"

    items.each do |item|
      flag = flags[item['country']] || "🏳️"

      if item['gid'].present?
        country_link = build_sheet_link(sheet_link, item['gid'])
        country_label = "<#{country_link}|*#{item['country']}*>"
      else
        country_label = "*#{item['country']}*"
      end

      message += "#{flag} #{country_label}: #{item['events_count']} events\n"

      # US → also show San Francisco sub-entry
      if item['country'] == "United States"
        sf_flag = flags["San Francisco"]
        sf_gid = "287958351"
        sf_link = build_sheet_link(sheet_link, sf_gid)
        sf_label = "<#{sf_link}|*San Francisco*>"

        sf_item = events_list.find { |e| e['country'].to_s.include?("San Francisco") }
        sf_count = sf_item.present? ? sf_item['events_count'].to_i : 0

        message += "   ↳ #{sf_flag} #{sf_label}: included above (#{sf_count} events)\n"
      end
    end

    message += "\n"
  end

  total = filtered.sum { |item| item['events_count'].to_i }
  message += "📈 *Total: #{total} events*"

  # ===== ADD-ON: Competitor Events section (from Sheet 'col_' fields) =====
  if competitor_events.any?
    comp_gid  = "674104543"
    comp_link = build_sheet_link(sheet_link, comp_gid)

    message += "\n\n🆕 <#{comp_link}|*New Competitor Events Added Today*> _(#{competitor_events.length})_\n"

    limit  = 15
    sorted = competitor_events.sort_by { |e| -(e['col_CI Score'].to_f) }

    sorted.first(limit).each do |e|
      ci    = e['col_CI Score'].to_f
      icons = "⚡" * (ci >= 0.8 ? 4 : ci >= 0.65 ? 3 : ci >= 0.5 ? 2 : 1)

      country = e['col_Country'].to_s.strip
      flag    = flags_by_code[country] || "🏳️"

      name  = e['col_Title'].to_s
      title = e['col_URL'].present? ? "<#{e['col_URL']}|*#{name}*>" : "*#{name}*"

      comps     = e['col_Competitors'].to_s.strip
      comps_str = comps.empty? ? "" : " — _#{comps}_"

      date_str = e['col_Start Date'].present? ? " (#{e['col_Start Date']})" : ""

      message += "#{flag} #{icons} #{title}#{date_str}#{comps_str}\n"
    end

    if competitor_events.length > limit
      message += "_…and #{competitor_events.length - limit} more (see sheet)_\n"
    end
  end
  # ===== END ADD-ON =====

  message += "\n📎 <#{sheet_link}|View Google Sheet>"
else
  message = "ℹ️ *Events Update - #{Time.now.strftime('%b %d, %Y')}*\n\nNo new events were added today."
  message += "\n\n📎 <#{sheet_link}|View Google Sheet>"
end

{ message: message }
